newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $15 MLN ORDER FROM RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $15 MLN ORDER FROM RUSSIA.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Monday it won an order worth about $15 million for switching technology to Russian telecommunications operators in different cities.
"Multiregional Transit Telecom of Russia and Nokia Telecommunications have signed a frame agreement for the supply of Nokia's NMT 450 MTX switches to Russia during 1996-1997," Nokia said.

NMT, which stands for Nordic Mobile Telephone, is an analogue mobile communications system. "NMT 450 technology is a suitable and cost-efficient system for our country," Multiregional Transit Telecom President V.Gurkin said in Nokia's statement.
Multiregional Transit Telecom is a Russian company offering transit connections for nationwide federal cellular networks.
